title: Does a streak help anyone learn?
caption:
A streak counts days. The Daily Nun looked at what it is built to do.

Duolingo says its streak taps "loss aversion" once the novelty fades. Research finds a missed day barely affects a habit, while seeing a streak reset can lead people to do less. The Daily Nun found no study showing that streaks improve learning.

reel.title: Does a streak help?
reel.voiceover: Does a streak help anyone learn? Duolingo says that once a streak stops feeling new, it taps loss aversion: a bias against losing something. Research says a missed day barely affects a habit. But seeing a streak reset can lead people to do less. What no study found here shows is that streaks help anyone learn more. Counting days is not the same as learning. The Daily Nun.

sources.title: The Duolingo Streak Uses Habit Research to Keep You Motivated
sources.author: Osman Mansur
sources.limits: The company describing its own design and reporting its own A/B test results (+1.7% seven-day retention from milestone animations; +0.38% relative daily active learners from two streak freezes). Not independently verified. Read in full on 2026-11-15.

sources.title: Improving the streak: Forming habits one lesson at a time
sources.author: Anton Yu
sources.limits: Company-reported result (over 40% more learners on a 7+ day streak after decoupling streaks from daily goals). Measures streak counts, not learning. Not independently verified.

sources.title: How are habits formed: Modelling habit formation in the real world
sources.author: Phillippa Lally, Cornelia H. M. van Jaarsveld, Henry W. W. Potts, Jane Wardle
sources.limits: Abstract only, read through Crossref on 2026-11-15. 96 volunteers, 82 analyzed, 39 with good model fit; small sample. Studied eating, drinking, or exercise habits, not app streaks or learning.

sources.title: On or Off Track: How (Broken) Streaks Affect Consumer Decisions
sources.author: Jackie Silverman, Alixandra Barasch
sources.limits: Abstract only, read on the University of Colorado's publication page on 2026-11-15. Measures subsequent engagement, not learning outcomes. Effect sizes and samples not read.
